blocks.raw: # Fetch import details by import ID
blocks.text: Fetch import details by import ID

blocks.raw: Data Exchange Framework allows you to fetch details of an import using import id.
blocks.text: Data Exchange Framework allows you to fetch details of an import using import id.

blocks.raw:
1. On the Settings page, click Master Data Management > Import File Details.
2. In the File Id drop-down box, choose the import id for fetching details.
3. The complete list of data uploaded will appear in the drop-down box
4. Click **Submit**
